pr_title: ddl: mitigate the issue that multiple owner might exist during force to be owner
pr_body:
<!--

Thank you for contributing to TiDB!

PR Title Format:
1. pkg [, pkg2, pkg3]: what's changed
2. *: what's changed

-->

### What problem does this PR solve?
<!--

Please create an issue first to describe the problem.

There MUST be one line starting with "Issue Number:  " and
linking the relevant issues via the "close" or "ref".

For more info, check https://pingcap.github.io/tidb-dev-guide/contribute-to-tidb/contribute-code.html#referring-to-an-issue.

-->

Issue Number: close #56924, #56713

Problem Summary:

### What changed and how does it work?
force owner, see https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/57185
older versions which don't have the fix of https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/54689, when upgrade and forcing newer version node to be owner, multiple owner might exist at the same time, this pr tries to mitigate the issue, see code comments for more detail

also mitigate https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/57003 by sleep after force to be owner

### Check List

Tests <!-- At least one of them must be included. -->

- [x] Unit test
- [ ] Integration test
- [x] Manual test (add detailed scripts or steps below)
  - start a v7.5.0 cluster with 3 TiDBs, rolling upgrade to this pr, success
  - start a v8.1.1 cluster with 3 TiDBs, rolling upgrade to this pr, success
  - start a v7.5.0 cluster with 3 TiDBs, stop all TiDBs, then start them with this pr, success
    - **Note: after this PR, we will aquire distributed lock before start domain, so in this case, the 2 non-owner node will not involve in schema version sync for upgrade DDL**
- [ ] No need to test
  > - [ ] I checked and no code files have been changed.
  > <!-- Or your custom  "No need to test" reasons -->

Side effects

- [ ] Performance regression: Consumes more CPU
- [ ] Performance regression: Consumes more Memory
- [ ] Breaking backward compatibility

Documentation

- [ ] Affects user behaviors
- [ ] Contains syntax changes
- [ ] Contains variable changes
- [ ] Contains experimental features
- [ ] Changes MySQL compatibility

### Release note
